claims.sentence: The primary objective is to estimate the impact of notification of primary care provider and patient of at least moderate incidental coronary artery calcification (CAC) on a prior non-gated chest CT on statin prescription rates at 4 months among patients without a clinical history of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease not actively on statin therapy.
